$comment: Single source of truth for every user-facing string in the Odivrelo iOS app. scripts/ios-generate-strings.sh generates Localizable.xcstrings and L10n.swift from it. Every key must carry el, en and sq; the generator refuses to write an incomplete file and LocalisationCompletenessTests asserts it again at test time. Default language is el.

a11y.brandMark.comment: VoiceOver label for the Odivrelo mark
a11y.brandMark.el: Σήμα Odivrelo: κύκλος που τον διασχίζει δρόμος, με πορτοκαλί σημείο προορισμού
a11y.brandMark.en: Odivrelo mark: a ring crossed by a road, with an orange destination point
a11y.brandMark.sq: Shenja Odivrelo: një rreth i përshkuar nga një rrugë, me një pikë portokalli destinacioni

a11y.errorAnnouncement.comment: Spoken when an error appears. %@ is the error text.

a11y.journeyCard.en: Departs %1$@ from %2$@, arrives %3$@ at %4$@, operated by %5$@
a11y.journeyCard.sq: Niset %1$@ nga %2$@, mbërrin %3$@ në %4$@, operuar nga %5$@

a11y.loadedAnnouncement.comment: Spoken when results finish loading. %lld is the number of results.

a11y.mapHint.comment: VoiceOver hint telling the reader the stop list, which is above the map on this screen, holds the same facts
a11y.mapHint.el: Κάθε πληροφορία του χάρτη υπάρχει και στον κατάλογο στάσεων πιο πάνω.
a11y.mapHint.en: Every fact on the map is also in the stop list above.
a11y.mapHint.sq: Çdo fakt në hartë ndodhet edhe në listën e ndalesave më sipër.

a11y.progressPercent.comment: VoiceOver value for a download progress bar. %lld is a percentage.

confidence.reviewed.comment: A human reviewer has checked this record

coverage.notCoveredEmpty.comment: Shown when the release states nothing about what it does not cover. Must not read as full coverage.
coverage.notCoveredEmpty.el: Αυτή η έκδοση δεν δηλώνει τι δεν καλύπτει. Μην το εκλάβετε ως πλήρη κάλυψη.
coverage.notCoveredEmpty.en: This release states nothing about what it does not cover. Do not read that as full coverage.
coverage.notCoveredEmpty.sq: Ky publikim nuk deklaron çfarë nuk mbulon. Mos e lexoni si mbulim të plotë.

coverage.notCoveredHeading.comment: Heading above the explicit list of what is not covered

coverage.operatorCount.comment: How many operators the release covers. %lld is the count.

deeplink.expiredBody.comment: Body for an expired link. %@ is the service date the link named.

deeplink.expiredBody.en: That link is for %@, which has passed.
deeplink.expiredBody.sq: Ajo lidhje është për %@, e cila ka kaluar.

deeplink.searchInstead.comment: Offers a useful next step after a bad link
deeplink.searchInstead.sq: Kërko për sot në vend të kësaj

deeplink.unknownBody.en: That link does not point at anything this version of Odivrelo knows.
deeplink.unknownBody.sq: Ajo lidhje nuk tregon asgjë që kjo version e Odivrelo e njeh.

deeplink.unknownTitle.comment: Title shown when a link points at nothing this build understands

demo.body.en: This release shows demonstration data for Aloria. Aloria does not exist, and no departure shown here is real.
demo.body.sq: Ky publikim shfaq të dhëna demonstrimi për Alorinë. Aloria nuk ekziston dhe asnjë nisje e shfaqur këtu nuk është reale.

demo.title.comment: Title of the permanent demonstration-data notice

detail.instructions.comment: Walking instructions to the boarding point

detail.mapUnavailableOffline.en: The map needs a connection. The stop list stays complete without it.
detail.mapUnavailableOffline.sq: Harta kërkon lidhje. Lista e ndalesave mbetet e plotë pa të.

detail.operatingDate.comment: The service date this journey belongs to

detail.pickupAllowed.comment: Boarding is allowed at this stop

detail.pickupCoordinate.comment: Boarding only by prior arrangement with the operator
detail.pickupCoordinate.el: Επιβίβαση κατόπιν συνεννόησης με τον μεταφορέα
detail.pickupCoordinate.en: Pick-up by arrangement with the operator

detail.provenance.comment: Section heading for where every fact came from

detail.retrievedAt.comment: When the source was retrieved. %@ is a date.

detail.stepFreeUnreviewed.comment: Step-free access has not been checked. Must not read as a no.
detail.stepFreeUnreviewed.el: Η πρόσβαση χωρίς σκαλοπάτια δεν έχει ελεγχθεί
detail.stepFreeUnreviewed.en: Step-free access has not been reviewed
detail.stepFreeUnreviewed.sq: Qasja pa shkallë nuk është shqyrtuar

detail.stops.comment: Section heading for the ordered stop list

detail.stopsListAlternative.comment: Explains the list carries everything the map shows
detail.stopsListAlternative.el: Ο κατάλογος στάσεων περιέχει κάθε πληροφορία που δείχνει ο χάρτης.
detail.stopsListAlternative.en: The stop list carries every fact the map shows.
detail.stopsListAlternative.sq: Lista e ndalesave përmban çdo fakt që tregon harta.

detail.verifiedAtLabel.comment: Row label for when a record was last verified

error.coreUnavailable.comment: The shared data core was not linked into this build. Must not read as a temporary network problem.
error.coreUnavailable.el: Ο κοινός πυρήνας δεδομένων του Odivrelo δεν περιλαμβάνεται σε αυτή την έκδοση της εφαρμογής, οπότε δεν υπάρχουν δεδομένα δρομολογίων. Δεν πρόκειται για πρόβλημα δικτύου.
error.coreUnavailable.en: The shared Odivrelo data core is not part of this build, so there is no timetable data. This is not a network problem.
error.coreUnavailable.sq: Bërthama e përbashkët e të dhënave të Odivrelo nuk është pjesë e këtij ndërtimi, ndaj nuk ka të dhëna orari. Ky nuk është problem rrjeti.

error.decoding.comment: The answer did not match the published contract
error.decoding.el: Η απάντηση δεν ταιριάζει με το δημοσιευμένο συμβόλαιο δεδομένων.
error.decoding.en: The answer did not match the published data contract.
error.decoding.sq: Përgjigjja nuk përputhej me kontratën e publikuar të të dhënave.

error.incompleteData.comment: Title when a release is installed but some of its packs are missing
error.incompleteData.sq: Të dhënat e instaluara janë të paplota.

error.incompleteDataHint.comment: What to do: finish the install from the Offline screen
error.incompleteDataHint.el: Ανοίξτε τα Εκτός σύνδεσης για να ολοκληρώσετε την εγκατάσταση των πακέτων που λείπουν.
error.incompleteDataHint.en: Open Offline to finish installing the packs that are missing.
error.incompleteDataHint.sq: Hapni Jashtë linje për të përfunduar instalimin e paketave që mungojnë.

error.integrity.comment: A downloaded pack failed its SHA-256 check
error.integrity.el: Το ληφθέν πακέτο απέτυχε στον έλεγχο ακεραιότητας και δεν εγκαταστάθηκε.
error.integrity.en: The downloaded pack failed its integrity check and was not installed.
error.integrity.sq: Paketa e shkarkuar dështoi kontrollin e integritetit dhe nuk u instalua.

error.interrupted.el: Η λήψη διακόπηκε. Μπορείτε να συνεχίσετε από εκεί που σταμάτησε.
error.interrupted.en: The download was interrupted. You can resume from where it stopped.
error.interrupted.sq: Shkarkimi u ndërpre. Mund ta vazhdoni aty ku ndaloi.

error.invalidRequest.comment: The request was rejected. %@ names the field.
error.invalidRequest.en: The request was rejected on the field %@.

error.noDataInstalled.comment: Title when the device holds no offline release at all, which is the first screen of a new installation
error.noDataInstalled.sq: Ende nuk janë instaluar të dhëna.

error.noDataInstalledHint.comment: What to do about it: go to the Offline screen and install a release
error.noDataInstalledHint.el: Ανοίξτε τα Εκτός σύνδεσης και εγκαταστήστε μια έκδοση δεδομένων. Μετά μπορείτε να αναζητήσετε χωρίς σύνδεση.
error.noDataInstalledHint.en: Open Offline and install a data release. After that you can search without a connection.
error.noDataInstalledHint.sq: Hapni Jashtë linje dhe instaloni një version të dhënash. Më pas mund të kërkoni pa lidhje.

error.noOfflineDataForDate.comment: Title when no timetable pack is held for the requested date. Never says no service runs that date
error.noOfflineDataForDate.el: Δεν υπάρχουν δεδομένα εκτός σύνδεσης για αυτή την ημερομηνία.
error.noOfflineDataForDate.en: No offline data for this date.
error.noOfflineDataForDate.sq: Nuk ka të dhëna jashtë linje për këtë datë.

error.noOfflineDataForDateHint.comment: Explains that this says nothing about whether service runs, and offers the Offline screen
error.noOfflineDataForDateHint.el: Αυτό δεν σημαίνει ότι δεν εκτελείται δρομολόγιο. Η συσκευή απλώς δεν κρατά πρόγραμμα για αυτή την ημερομηνία. Ανοίξτε τα Εκτός σύνδεσης για να κατεβάσετε την ημέρα.
error.noOfflineDataForDateHint.en: This does not mean no service runs. The device simply holds no timetable for this date. Open Offline to download the day.
error.noOfflineDataForDateHint.sq: Kjo nuk do të thotë se nuk ka shërbim. Pajisja thjesht nuk mban orar për këtë datë. Hapni Jashtë linje për ta shkarkuar ditën.

error.notFound.comment: The requested record no longer exists in this release
error.notFound.el: Αυτή η εγγραφή δεν υπάρχει σε αυτή την έκδοση δεδομένων.
error.notFound.en: This record does not exist in this data release.
error.notFound.sq: Ky regjistrim nuk ekziston në këtë publikim të të dhënave.

error.offlineHint.el: Τα αποθηκευμένα ταξίδια και τα κατεβασμένα δεδομένα εξακολουθούν να λειτουργούν.
error.offlineHint.en: Saved trips and downloaded data still work.
error.offlineHint.sq: Udhëtimet e ruajtura dhe të dhënat e shkarkuara ende funksionojnë.

error.openOffline.comment: Button that takes the person to the Offline packs screen

error.packIo.comment: A pack could not be written to the device
error.packIo.el: Το πακέτο δεν μπόρεσε να γραφτεί στη συσκευή.
error.packIo.en: The pack could not be written to the device.
error.packIo.sq: Paketa nuk mund të shkruhej në pajisje.

error.packNotInManifest.comment: A pack was requested that the published manifest does not list
error.packNotInManifest.el: Αυτό το πακέτο δεν υπάρχει στον δημοσιευμένο κατάλογο.
error.packNotInManifest.en: That pack is not in the published manifest.
error.packNotInManifest.sq: Ajo paketë nuk është në manifestin e publikuar.

error.packStorageFull.comment: Not enough free space for a pack
error.packStorageFull.el: Δεν υπάρχει αρκετός ελεύθερος χώρος για αυτό το πακέτο.
error.packStorageFull.en: There is not enough free space for this pack.
error.packStorageFull.sq: Nuk ka hapësirë të mjaftueshme për këtë paketë.

error.releaseMismatch.comment: Local packs and server answers come from different releases
error.releaseMismatch.el: Τα αποθηκευμένα δεδομένα προέρχονται από άλλη έκδοση από τον διακομιστή. Εμφανίζονται τα αποθηκευμένα δεδομένα και η ηλικία τους.
error.releaseMismatch.en: Your stored data comes from a different release than the server. The stored release and its age are shown instead.
error.releaseMismatch.sq: Të dhënat tuaja të ruajtura vijnë nga një publikim tjetër nga serveri. Në vend të tyre shfaqet publikimi i ruajtur dhe mosha e tij.

error.server.comment: Server failure. %lld is the HTTP status.

error.storage.comment: Not enough free space. %1$@ is required, %2$@ is available.
error.storage.en: %1$@ is needed but only %2$@ is free.
error.storage.sq: Nevojiten %1$@ por vetëm %2$@ janë të lira.

error.unauthorized.comment: A public surface unexpectedly demanded a token
error.unauthorized.el: Αυτή η δημόσια υπηρεσία ζήτησε απροσδόκητα εξουσιοδότηση.
error.unauthorized.en: This public service unexpectedly demanded authorisation.
error.unauthorized.sq: Ky shërbim publik kërkoi papritur autorizim.

error.unavailable.comment: Service is reachable but cannot answer
error.unavailable.el: Η υπηρεσία δεν μπορεί να απαντήσει αυτή τη στιγμή.
error.unavailable.en: The service cannot answer right now.
error.unavailable.sq: Shërbimi nuk mund të përgjigjet tani.

error.unreadableData.comment: Title when installed data cannot be decoded and must be installed again
error.unreadableData.en: The installed data cannot be read.
error.unreadableData.sq: Të dhënat e instaluara nuk mund të lexohen.

error.unreadableDataHint.comment: What to do: reinstall from the Offline screen
error.unreadableDataHint.el: Ανοίξτε τα Εκτός σύνδεσης και εγκαταστήστε ξανά την έκδοση δεδομένων.
error.unreadableDataHint.en: Open Offline and install the data release again.
error.unreadableDataHint.sq: Hapni Jashtë linje dhe instaloni përsëri versionin e të dhënave.

favourites.empty.el: Δεν έχετε αποθηκεύσει ακόμη αγαπημένους τόπους.
favourites.empty.en: You have not saved any favourite places yet.
favourites.empty.sq: Ende nuk keni ruajtur vende të preferuara.

filters.accessible.el: Μόνο με ελεγμένη πρόσβαση χωρίς σκαλοπάτια
filters.accessible.sq: Vetëm hipje pa shkallë e shqyrtuar

filters.activeCount.comment: Number of active filters. %lld is the count.

filters.departureWindow.comment: Filter section heading for a departure time range

filters.excludeOvernight.el: Χωρίς δρομολόγια που διασχίζουν τα μεσάνυχτα

filters.maxDuration.comment: Toggle limiting results to journeys no longer than a chosen time

filters.sortBy.comment: Heading for how results are ordered

filters.sortDuration.comment: Sort results by how long the journey takes

freshness.checkedDays.comment: How long ago the source was checked. %lld is days.

freshness.checkedHours.comment: How long ago the source was checked. %lld is hours.

freshness.unknown.comment: Freshness badge when the core reported no state

geometry.orderedStopsOnly.comment: Route geometry is straight lines between ordered stops, not the real road
geometry.orderedStopsOnly.el: Ευθείες γραμμές μεταξύ διαδοχικών στάσεων, όχι η πραγματική διαδρομή
geometry.orderedStopsOnly.en: Straight lines between ordered stops, not the real road
geometry.orderedStopsOnly.sq: Vija të drejta mes ndalesave të radhitura, jo rruga reale

geometry.osmCandidate.comment: Route geometry from an open map source, not reviewed
geometry.osmCandidate.el: Υποψήφια χάραξη από ανοικτό χάρτη, χωρίς έλεγχο
geometry.osmCandidate.en: Candidate shape from an open map source, not reviewed
geometry.osmCandidate.sq: Formë kandidate nga një burim i hapur hartash, e pashqyrtuar

geometry.rejected.comment: Route geometry was rejected in review

offline.attempt.comment: Which download attempt this is. %lld is the attempt number.

offline.available.comment: Section heading for packs that can be downloaded

offline.baseMapUnavailable.comment: Offline capability statement about base map imagery
offline.baseMapUnavailable.el: Ο χάρτης υποβάθρου δεν αποθηκεύεται και χρειάζεται σύνδεση.
offline.baseMapUnavailable.en: The base map is not stored and needs a connection.
offline.baseMapUnavailable.sq: Harta bazë nuk ruhet dhe kërkon lidhje.

offline.currentRelease.comment: Section heading for the release currently in use

offline.installedAt.comment: When a pack was installed. %@ is a date.

offline.installedAtLabel.comment: Row label for when a pack was installed

offline.manifestUnreachable.comment: The published manifest could not be read at all
offline.manifestUnreachable.el: Ο κατάλογος εκδόσεων δεν είναι προσβάσιμος. Τα ήδη εγκατεστημένα δεδομένα εξακολουθούν να λειτουργούν.
offline.manifestUnreachable.en: The release manifest could not be reached. Data already installed still works.
offline.manifestUnreachable.sq: Manifesti i publikimit nuk u arrit. Të dhënat e instaluara ende funksionojnë.

offline.mapsNote.comment: Must be explicit about what is and is not available offline
offline.mapsNote.el: Τα ωράρια, οι στάσεις και οι θέσεις επιβίβασης λειτουργούν χωρίς σύνδεση. Ο χάρτης υποβάθρου δεν αποθηκεύεται και χρειάζεται σύνδεση.

offline.mapsNote.sq: Oraret, ndalesat dhe vendet e hipjes funksionojnë pa internet. Harta bazë nuk ruhet dhe kërkon lidhje.

offline.noPrevious.sq: Nuk ruhet asnjë publikim i mëparshëm.

offline.noneInstalled.comment: Shown when no offline pack has been downloaded yet
offline.noneInstalled.el: Δεν έχει εγκατασταθεί κανένα πακέτο ακόμη.
offline.noneInstalled.en: No pack has been installed yet.
offline.noneInstalled.sq: Asnjë paketë nuk është instaluar ende.

offline.phaseResuming.comment: Pack download phase after an interruption

offline.publishedLabel.comment: Row label for when a release or pack was published

offline.releaseId.comment: Data release identifier. %@ is the identifier.

offline.releaseLabel.comment: Row label for the installed data release identifier

offline.rollback.comment: Action that returns to the previously installed release
offline.rollback.en: Roll back to the previous release

offline.rollbackTargetLabel.comment: Row label for the release a rollback would return to

offline.routeGeometryAvailable.sq: Format e rrugëve janë të ruajtura.

offline.stopCoordinatesAvailable.sq: Koordinatat e ndalesave janë të ruajtura.

offline.storageUsed.comment: How much space the installed packs take. %@ is a formatted size.

offline.storageUsedLabel.comment: Row label for how much space installed packs take

offline.updateAvailable.comment: A newer release of this pack exists

offline.verifying.comment: Verifying the SHA-256 digest before installing

onboarding.honestyTitle.comment: Heading above the statement about tickets
onboarding.honestyTitle.el: Τι κάνει και τι δεν κάνει
onboarding.honestyTitle.en: What this app does and does not do
onboarding.honestyTitle.sq: Çfarë bën dhe çfarë nuk bën

onboarding.language.comment: Language chooser heading on first launch

onboarding.noTickets.comment: Must be unambiguous: the product never sells or issues tickets
onboarding.noTickets.el: Το Odivrelo δεν πουλά ούτε εκδίδει ποτέ εισιτήρια. Σας δείχνει το δρομολόγιο και σας παραπέμπει στον μεταφορέα.
onboarding.noTickets.en: Odivrelo never sells or issues tickets. It shows you the schedule and hands you over to the operator.
onboarding.noTickets.sq: Odivrelo nuk shet dhe nuk lëshon kurrë bileta. Ju tregon orarin dhe ju kalon te operatori.

onboarding.noTracking.el: Χωρίς παρακολούθηση και χωρίς αναλυτικά στοιχεία.

onboarding.offlineFirst.sq: Kërkimi funksionon pa internet pasi të keni shkarkuar të dhënat.

onboarding.start.comment: Button that leaves onboarding for search

operator.notAffiliated.comment: Makes the lack of affiliation explicit
operator.notAffiliated.el: Το Odivrelo δεν συνδέεται με αυτόν τον μεταφορέα και δεν τον εκπροσωπεί.
operator.notAffiliated.en: Odivrelo is not affiliated with this operator and does not represent it.
operator.notAffiliated.sq: Odivrelo nuk është e lidhur me këtë operator dhe nuk e përfaqëson atë.

operator.official.comment: Link to the operator's own website

operator.routeCount.comment: Number of routes. %lld is the count.

operator.stopCount.comment: Number of stops. %lld is the count.

place.disambiguationHint.el: Ένας σταθμός περιέχει περισσότερες θέσεις επιβίβασης. Επιλέξτε τον σταθμό αν δεν είστε βέβαιοι.
place.disambiguationHint.en: A terminal contains several boarding points. Choose the terminal if you are not sure.
place.disambiguationHint.sq: Një terminal përmban disa vende hipjeje. Zgjidhni terminalin nëse nuk jeni i sigurt.

place.noMatches.comment: Empty state in the place picker
place.noMatches.el: Κανένας τόπος δεν ταιριάζει με αυτή την αναζήτηση.
place.noMatches.sq: Asnjë vend nuk përputhet me atë kërkim.

place.searchPlaceholder.comment: Search field in the place picker

place.terminal.comment: Badge marking a terminal, which groups boarding points

purchase.continueToOperator.comment: Primary action that opens the operator's own sales page. %@ is the operator name.

purchase.heading.comment: Section heading above the purchase handoff

purchase.howToBuy.comment: Shown instead of a buy action when no online sale exists

purchase.notVerified.comment: The sales channel has never been verified

purchase.onboard.comment: Tickets are sold on the vehicle

purchase.opensInBrowser.sq: Hap faqen e vetë operatorit. Do të ktheheni këtu, në të njëjtën gjendje.

purchase.operatorHandles.comment: Explains the operator owns payment and refunds
purchase.operatorHandles.el: Ο μεταφορέας διαχειρίζεται πληρωμή, εισιτήρια, αλλαγές και επιστροφές. Το Odivrelo δεν εμπλέκεται.
purchase.operatorHandles.en: The operator handles payment, tickets, changes and refunds. Odivrelo is not involved.
purchase.operatorHandles.sq: Operatori menaxhon pagesën, biletat, ndryshimet dhe rimbursimet. Odivrelo nuk përfshihet.

purchase.ticketOffice.comment: Heading for a physical ticket office

purchase.unknownElectronic.comment: Deliberately not the phrase electronic ticketing unavailable

purchase.verifiedAt.comment: When the sales channel was last verified. %@ is a date.

quality.approximate.comment: Time quality: the source gives only an approximate time

quality.scheduled.comment: Time quality: published by the operator

reminders.denied.el: Οι ειδοποιήσεις δεν επιτρέπονται για το Odivrelo.
reminders.denied.en: Notifications are not allowed for Odivrelo.

reminders.deniedHint.el: Μπορείτε να τις επιτρέψετε στις Ρυθμίσεις. Το αποθηκευμένο ταξίδι λειτουργεί κανονικά χωρίς υπενθύμιση.
reminders.deniedHint.en: You can allow them in Settings. The saved trip works normally without a reminder.
reminders.deniedHint.sq: Mund t'i lejoni te Cilësimet. Udhëtimi i ruajtur funksionon normalisht pa kujtesë.

reminders.enable.comment: Opt in to a local reminder for a saved trip

reminders.leadMinutes.comment: A lead time in minutes. %lld is the number.

reminders.leadTime.comment: How long before departure the reminder fires

reminders.leadTimeValue.comment: Accessible value for the reminder lead-time control. %lld is minutes.

reminders.notificationBody.comment: Body of the local notification. %1$@ is the departure time, %2$@ is the boarding point.

reminders.notificationTitle.comment: Title of the local notification itself

reminders.privacyNote.comment: States exactly what a reminder payload contains
reminders.privacyNote.el: Η υπενθύμιση περιέχει μόνο την ώρα και τον τόπο αναχώρησης. Ποτέ όνομα επιβάτη, κωδικό κράτησης, εικόνα εισιτηρίου ή γραμμωτό κώδικα.
reminders.privacyNote.en: A reminder carries only the departure time and place. Never a passenger name, booking reference, ticket image or barcode.
reminders.privacyNote.sq: Një kujtesë përmban vetëm orën dhe vendin e nisjes. Kurrë emër udhëtari, referencë rezervimi, imazh bilete ose barkod.

reminders.revoked.comment: Permission was granted before and has since been withdrawn
reminders.revoked.el: Η άδεια ειδοποιήσεων αφαιρέθηκε, οπότε οι προγραμματισμένες υπενθυμίσεις δεν θα εμφανιστούν.
reminders.revoked.en: Notification permission was withdrawn, so scheduled reminders will not appear.
reminders.revoked.sq: Leja e njoftimeve u hoq, ndaj kujtesat e planifikuara nuk do të shfaqen.

reminders.scheduled.comment: Confirmation that a reminder exists. %@ is the fire date.

reminders.timeZoneChanged.comment: The device time zone changed and reminders were rescheduled
reminders.timeZoneChanged.el: Η ζώνη ώρας της συσκευής άλλαξε. Οι υπενθυμίσεις επαναπρογραμματίστηκαν με βάση την ώρα Ευρώπη/Αθήνα του δρομολογίου.
reminders.timeZoneChanged.en: The device time zone changed. Reminders were rescheduled against the journey's Europe/Athens time.
reminders.timeZoneChanged.sq: Zona kohore e pajisjes ndryshoi. Kujtesat u riplanifikuan sipas kohës Evropë/Athinë të udhëtimit.

results.arrivesNextDay.comment: Explains the arrival is on the following calendar day

results.count.comment: Number of results found. %lld is the count.

results.crossesMidnight.comment: Marker on a journey that arrives after midnight

results.durationHoursOnly.comment: A journey that is a whole number of hours. %lld is hours.

results.durationMinutes.comment: Journey duration in hours and minutes. %1$lld is hours, %2$lld is minutes.

results.durationMinutesOnly.comment: A journey shorter than an hour. %lld is minutes. Avoids reading as '0h 45m'.

results.emptyNoOfflineData.comment: No journeys pack is installed for this date. Deliberately NOT the same as 'no service on this date'.
results.emptyNoOfflineData.el: Δεν υπάρχουν αποθηκευμένα δεδομένα για αυτή την ημερομηνία.
results.emptyNoOfflineData.en: There is no offline data for this date.
results.emptyNoOfflineData.sq: Nuk ka të dhëna offline për këtë datë.

results.emptyNoOfflineDataHint.comment: What to do about a missing journeys pack. Must not claim anything about whether a service runs.
results.emptyNoOfflineDataHint.el: Δεν γνωρίζουμε αν εκτελείται δρομολόγιο αυτή την ημέρα. Συνδεθείτε ή κατεβάστε τα δεδομένα αυτής της ημερομηνίας για να ελέγξετε.
results.emptyNoOfflineDataHint.en: Whether a service runs that day is not known here. Connect, or download this date's data, to find out.
results.emptyNoOfflineDataHint.sq: Nuk dihet këtu nëse kryhet ndonjë shërbim atë ditë. Lidhuni, ose shkarkoni të dhënat e kësaj date, për ta zbuluar.

results.emptyNoService.comment: No service runs on the chosen date
results.emptyNoService.el: Κανένα δρομολόγιο δεν εκτελείται αυτή την ημερομηνία.
results.emptyNoService.en: No service runs on this date.
results.emptyNoService.sq: Asnjë shërbim nuk kryhet në këtë datë.

results.emptyOutsideCoverage.comment: The corridor is outside the released coverage
results.emptyOutsideCoverage.el: Αυτή η διαδρομή δεν καλύπτεται από την τρέχουσα έκδοση δεδομένων.
results.emptyOutsideCoverage.en: This corridor is not covered by the current data release.
results.emptyOutsideCoverage.sq: Ky korridor nuk mbulohet nga publikimi aktual i të dhënave.

results.emptyOutsideCoverageHint.comment: What to do when a corridor is outside the release's coverage. Points at the coverage page rather than repeating its heading.
results.emptyOutsideCoverageHint.el: Δείτε στις Ρυθμίσεις τι καλύπτει και τι δεν καλύπτει αυτή η έκδοση δεδομένων.
results.emptyOutsideCoverageHint.en: Settings lists exactly what this data release does and does not cover.
results.emptyOutsideCoverageHint.sq: Cilësimet listojnë saktësisht çfarë mbulon dhe çfarë nuk mbulon ky publikim.

results.emptyReasonUnstated.comment: The release returned no journeys and gave no reason this build recognises. Must not assert that no service runs.
results.emptyReasonUnstated.el: Δεν επιστράφηκε κανένα δρομολόγιο και η έκδοση δεδομένων δεν εξηγεί γιατί.
results.emptyReasonUnstated.en: No journeys came back, and the data release does not say why.
results.emptyReasonUnstated.sq: Nuk u kthye asnjë udhëtim dhe publikimi i të dhënave nuk shpjegon pse.

results.emptySamePlace.comment: Origin and destination are the same
results.emptySamePlace.el: Η αφετηρία και ο προορισμός είναι ο ίδιος τόπος.
results.emptySamePlace.en: The origin and the destination are the same place.
results.emptySamePlace.sq: Nisja dhe destinacioni janë i njëjti vend.

results.fareIndicative.comment: Marks a fare as indicative, not a price the product can honour. %@ is the formatted amount.

results.intermediateStops.comment: Number of intermediate stops. %lld is the count.

results.noFare.comment: No fare is published for this service

results.partialWarning.comment: Shown above a partial result list
results.partialWarning.el: Ορισμένα δρομολόγια αυτής της ημέρας δεν έχουν ελεγχθεί ακόμη, οπότε ο κατάλογος μπορεί να είναι ελλιπής.
results.partialWarning.en: Some services on this date have not been reviewed yet, so this list may be incomplete.
results.partialWarning.sq: Disa shërbime të kësaj date nuk janë shqyrtuar ende, ndaj kjo listë mund të jetë e paplotë.

results.scheduledOnly.comment: Banner: this release carries scheduled data only
results.scheduledOnly.el: Προγραμματισμένα δεδομένα μόνο. Η ζωντανή παρακολούθηση δεν είναι διαθέσιμη σε αυτή την έκδοση.
results.scheduledOnly.en: Scheduled data only. Live tracking is not available in this release.
results.scheduledOnly.sq: Vetëm të dhëna të planifikuara. Gjurmimi i drejtpërdrejtë nuk ofrohet në këtë publikim.

results.servedFromCache.comment: The answer came from installed packs rather than the network. %@ is the release age.

rights.pending.comment: Rights status: permission has been requested

rights.prohibited.comment: Rights status: reuse is not permitted

rights.unknown.comment: Rights status has not been established

search.dateZoneNote.comment: Explains the time zone the service date is read in
search.dateZoneNote.el: Οι ημερομηνίες δρομολογίων διαβάζονται σε ώρα Ευρώπη/Αθήνα.
search.dateZoneNote.en: Service dates are read in Europe/Athens time.
search.dateZoneNote.sq: Datat e shërbimit lexohen në kohën Evropë/Athinë.

search.needBothPlaces.en: Choose an origin and a destination.
search.needBothPlaces.sq: Zgjidhni një nisje dhe një destinacion.

search.recentEmpty.comment: Shown when no search has been made yet

search.submit.comment: Primary action. Deliberately not the word Go.

search.swap.comment: Button that swaps origin and destination

settings.aboutMark.comment: What the brand mark means. Used as the accessibility description of the mark too.
settings.aboutMark.el: Το σήμα είναι ένας κύκλος που τον διασχίζει ένας δρόμος προς ένα πορτοκαλί σημείο: η διαδρομή και ο προορισμός της.
settings.aboutMark.en: The mark is a ring crossed by a road that leads to an orange point: the journey, and where it takes you.
settings.aboutMark.sq: Shenja është një rreth që e përshkon një rrugë drejt një pike portokalli: udhëtimi dhe vendi ku të çon.

settings.commit.comment: Source commit row. %@ is the commit identifier.

settings.commitLabel.comment: Row label for the source commit the build came from

settings.contractLabel.comment: Row label for the data contract version the build implements

settings.coverage.comment: Row that opens the coverage page

settings.dataCoreFixture.comment: A development build is running on fixture data
settings.dataCoreFixture.el: Αυτή είναι έκδοση ανάπτυξης που χρησιμοποιεί δεδομένα επίδειξης.
settings.dataCoreFixture.en: This is a development build running on fixture data.
settings.dataCoreFixture.sq: Ky është një ndërtim zhvillimi që përdor të dhëna demonstrimi.

settings.dataCoreLinked.comment: The shared Kotlin core is present
settings.dataCoreLinked.el: Ο κοινός πυρήνας δεδομένων είναι συνδεδεμένος.
settings.dataCoreLinked.en: The shared data core is linked.
settings.dataCoreLinked.sq: Bërthama e përbashkët e të dhënave është e lidhur.

settings.dataCoreMissing.comment: The shared Kotlin core is absent from this build
settings.dataCoreMissing.el: Ο κοινός πυρήνας δεδομένων δεν είναι συνδεδεμένος σε αυτή την έκδοση.
settings.dataCoreMissing.en: The shared data core is not linked in this build.
settings.dataCoreMissing.sq: Bërthama e përbashkët e të dhënave nuk është e lidhur në këtë ndërtim.

settings.diagnostics.comment: Section heading for diagnostics that carry no secrets

settings.diagnosticsNote.el: Τα διαγνωστικά περιέχουν μόνο εκδόσεις, κατάσταση δεδομένων και μεγέθη. Κανένα προσωπικό στοιχείο, κανένα εισιτήριο και κανένα μυστικό.
settings.diagnosticsNote.en: Diagnostics carry only versions, data state and sizes. No personal detail, no ticket and no secret.
settings.diagnosticsNote.sq: Diagnostika përmban vetëm versione, gjendjen e të dhënave dhe madhësi. Asnjë detaj personal, asnjë biletë dhe asnjë sekret.

settings.nameOrigin.comment: Honest statement about the invented name. Must not claim it is a Greek word.
settings.nameOrigin.el: Το Odivrelo είναι εφευρημένο όνομα. Δεν είναι ελληνική λέξη και δεν είναι μετάφραση κάποιας λέξης.
settings.nameOrigin.en: Odivrelo is an invented name. It is not a Greek word, and it is not a translation of anything.
settings.nameOrigin.sq: Odivrelo është emër i shpikur. Nuk është fjalë greke dhe nuk është përkthim i ndonjë fjale.

settings.preferAccessibleJourneys.comment: Default the accessibility filter on for every search
settings.preferAccessibleJourneys.el: Προεπιλογή σε δρομολόγια με ελεγμένη πρόσβαση χωρίς σκαλοπάτια
settings.preferAccessibleJourneys.en: Default to journeys with reviewed step-free boarding
settings.preferAccessibleJourneys.sq: Parazgjidh udhëtimet me hipje pa shkallë të shqyrtuar

settings.privacyBody.el: Το Odivrelo δεν έχει λογαριασμούς, δεν συλλέγει αναλυτικά στοιχεία και δεν περιέχει ιχνηλάτες τρίτων. Οι αναζητήσεις, τα αγαπημένα, τα ταξίδια και τα εισιτήριά σας παραμένουν στη συσκευή.
settings.privacyBody.en: Odivrelo has no accounts, collects no analytics and contains no third-party trackers. Your searches, favourites, trips and tickets stay on the device.
settings.privacyBody.sq: Odivrelo nuk ka llogari, nuk mbledh analitikë dhe nuk përmban gjurmues të palëve të treta. Kërkimet, të preferuarat, udhëtimet dhe biletat tuaja mbeten në pajisje.

settings.reduceMotionNote.comment: Explains the app already follows the system setting
settings.reduceMotionNote.el: Το Odivrelo ακολουθεί τη ρύθμιση Μείωση κίνησης της συσκευής.
settings.reduceMotionNote.en: Odivrelo follows the device's Reduce Motion setting.
settings.reduceMotionNote.sq: Odivrelo ndjek cilësimin Zvogëlo lëvizjen të pajisjes.

settings.version.comment: App version row. %1$@ is the version, %2$@ is the build number.

settings.versionLabel.comment: Row label for the app version

sources.empty.comment: Empty state on the source registry
sources.empty.el: Δεν έχουν καταχωρηθεί πηγές σε αυτή την έκδοση.
sources.empty.en: No sources are registered in this release.
sources.empty.sq: Asnjë burim nuk është regjistruar në këtë publikim.

stop.crossesMidnight.comment: Marks a departure whose journey arrives after midnight

tab.trips.comment: Tab title for saved trips and favourites

trips.cachedRelease.comment: Names the cached data release a saved trip came from. %@ is the release identifier.
trips.cachedRelease.sq: Publikim i ruajtur i të dhënave %@

trips.empty.en: You have not saved a trip yet.
trips.empty.sq: Ende nuk keni ruajtur asnjë udhëtim.

trips.readyBody.comment: Explains that everything needed is stored on the device
trips.readyBody.el: Όλα όσα χρειάζεστε για αυτό το ταξίδι είναι αποθηκευμένα στη συσκευή και λειτουργούν χωρίς σύνδεση.
trips.readyBody.en: Everything you need for this trip is stored on the device and works without a connection.
trips.readyBody.sq: Gjithçka që ju nevojitet për këtë udhëtim ruhet në pajisje dhe funksionon pa lidhje.

trips.readyIncomplete.comment: Some part of the trip is not stored offline
trips.readyIncomplete.el: Μέρος αυτού του ταξιδιού δεν είναι αποθηκευμένο χωρίς σύνδεση.
trips.readyIncomplete.en: Part of this trip is not stored for offline use.
trips.readyIncomplete.sq: Një pjesë e këtij udhëtimi nuk ruhet për përdorim pa internet.

trips.readyTitle.comment: Heading of the Trip Ready summary

trips.releaseAgeDays.comment: How old the cached release is. %lld is days.

trips.releaseAgeUnknown.comment: The age of the cached release could not be determined

trips.save.comment: Action that saves a journey for offline use

wallet.backupExcluded.comment: Confirms the tickets directory is excluded from backup

wallet.backupNotExcluded.comment: Warns that the backup exclusion could not be set
wallet.backupNotExcluded.el: Η εξαίρεση από τα αντίγραφα ασφαλείας δεν μπόρεσε να οριστεί
wallet.backupNotExcluded.en: The backup exclusion could not be set
wallet.backupNotExcluded.sq: Përjashtimi nga rezervimi nuk u vendos

wallet.deleteConfirm.el: Να διαγραφεί οριστικά αυτό το εισιτήριο από τη συσκευή;
wallet.deleteConfirm.en: Permanently delete this ticket from the device?
wallet.deleteConfirm.sq: Të fshihet përgjithmonë kjo biletë nga pajisja?

wallet.empty.el: Δεν έχετε εισαγάγει κανένα αρχείο εισιτηρίου.
wallet.empty.en: You have not imported any ticket file.
wallet.empty.sq: Nuk keni importuar asnjë skedar bilete.

wallet.fileSize.comment: Size of an imported ticket file. %@ is a formatted size.

wallet.import.comment: Action that opens the document picker

wallet.importExplainer.comment: Explains the wallet only ever holds files the person chose
wallet.importExplainer.el: Το Odivrelo αποθηκεύει μόνο αρχεία που επιλέγετε εσείς. Δεν διαβάζει email, δεν στέλνει τίποτα και δεν ανεβάζει ποτέ ένα εισιτήριο.
wallet.importExplainer.en: Odivrelo stores only files you choose yourself. It reads no email, sends nothing, and never uploads a ticket.
wallet.importExplainer.sq: Odivrelo ruan vetëm skedarë që i zgjidhni vetë. Nuk lexon email, nuk dërgon asgjë dhe nuk ngarkon kurrë një biletë.

wallet.importedAt.comment: When a ticket was imported. %@ is a date.

wallet.pickerDenied.comment: The file could not be read because access was refused
wallet.pickerDenied.el: Δεν δόθηκε πρόσβαση σε αυτό το αρχείο.
wallet.pickerDenied.en: Access to that file was not granted.
wallet.pickerDenied.sq: Qasja në atë skedar nuk u dha.

wallet.readFailed.comment: The stored file could not be opened
wallet.readFailed.el: Αυτό το αρχείο δεν μπόρεσε να ανοίξει.
wallet.readFailed.en: This file could not be opened.
wallet.readFailed.sq: Ky skedar nuk mund të hapej.

wallet.storageExplainer.comment: Where a ticket is stored and how
wallet.storageExplainer.el: Τα εισιτήρια αποθηκεύονται κρυπτογραφημένα στη συσκευή, εξαιρούνται από τα αντίγραφα ασφαλείας iCloud και iTunes, και διαγράφονται οριστικά όταν τα διαγράψετε.
wallet.storageExplainer.en: Tickets are stored encrypted on the device, excluded from iCloud and iTunes backups, and permanently removed when you delete them.
wallet.storageExplainer.sq: Biletat ruhen të enkriptuara në pajisje, përjashtohen nga rezervimet iCloud dhe iTunes, dhe fshihen përgjithmonë kur i fshini.

wallet.tooLarge.comment: The chosen file exceeds the size limit. %@ is the limit.
wallet.tooLarge.el: Το αρχείο ξεπερνά το όριο των %@.
wallet.tooLarge.en: The file is larger than the %@ limit.
wallet.tooLarge.sq: Skedari është më i madh se kufiri prej %@.

wallet.unsupportedType.comment: The chosen file is not a supported ticket format
wallet.unsupportedType.el: Αυτός ο τύπος αρχείου δεν υποστηρίζεται. Επιλέξτε PDF, PNG ή JPEG.
wallet.unsupportedType.en: That file type is not supported. Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG.
wallet.unsupportedType.sq: Ai lloj skedari nuk mbështetet. Zgjidhni një PDF, PNG ose JPEG.
